source: example — replace with the ADM bridge weight / clearance register (this file is illustrative, not a real register)
notes: rows[].limit_t = posted weight limit in tonnes (omit if none); rows[].clearance_m = vertical clearance in metres (omit if none). A row blocks heavy pump trucks when limit_t < heavy_vehicle_t (≈ pump + tare, default 12 t) or clearance_m < heavy_height_m (default 3.8 m). Road links whose midpoint lies within radius_m of (lon, lat) are cut in the heavy-vehicle travel matrix. Place the real file at exchange/bridges.json, or POST it to /api/feed/bridges, or set [feeds.bridges].url to pull it.
